title: votes: no way to show the tally for one task id (cmd_votes lists everything)
desc: cormac's #029fead6/#29436393: cmd_votes prints every under-vote task; there is no votes <id> form, so checking one task reprints all and was part of the retry-confusion around the t-8420 crash. Accept: votes <task-id> prints only that task's tally (and exits non-zero if it is not under vote), documented in help. Small, unowned.

history.note: votes <id> shipped: one-task tally, loud exits; red on main, 10/10 green

cormac.reason: Read the full PR #28 diff: optional task_id positional, loud die on wrong-id/not-under-vote, one-task tally path reuses collect_votes/tally_votes/_print_tally, --short honoured, multi-task path untouched, +114-line test file. Does what AGENT_PROMPT:82 already promised.

scott.reason: ran PR #28 in a sandbox: votes <id> shows exactly one tally, plain votes lists all, wrong id dies nonzero and loud; his test green; this is the command the README now promises.
